name: AGC-055 -- PowerShell Outbound Connection
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Ali. | AGC-055: powershell.exe initiated 4 outbound TCP connections to 10.10.40.10 using 3 cmdlets (Invoke-WebRequest, Invoke-RestMethod, Net.WebClient) across ports 443/80. 4 Sysmon EID 3, 1 EID 1 with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.

techniques.comment: AGC-055: powershell.exe (PID 4104) initiated 4 outbound TCP connections to 10.10.40.10 on ports 443/80 using Invoke-WebRequest, Invoke-RestMethod, and Net.WebClient. 4 Sysmon EID 3 events captured. ProcessGuid correlation to EID 1 reveals -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Temp\agc055-sim.ps1. Process identity (powershell.exe) is the primary detection signal. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.

AGC-055: PowerShell execution with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass from C:\Temp\ directory. Sysmon EID 1 captured process creation. Policy override + non-standard script path + outbound network connections = malicious PowerShell execution. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.
